title: Brackwater Weekly, episode 2. Infinite procedural urban sandbox in the browser
author: plastic_machinist
selftext:
Just to add a note about workflow- there's not anything too interesting there- I'm mainly just using Claude code within VSCode. 

Probably the most interesting thing there is how I've approached geometry, which I show towards the end of the video. I'm using a representation that's kinda Second Life "prims" meets parametric geometry, stored as lightweight data (JSON), and passed to a geometry compilation step that reports warnings and errors. This means that agents can make the models on their own. So far, that's worked well- Claude has been able to one-shot things like the benches, trash cans, etc. 

In the near future, I'll be setting up a closed loop to add more objects to the world. Should be fairly straightforward given that representation.
